text: {"lessons":["Frequent reversals and selling at losses did not clearly improve my results; make each trade conditional on a reasoned view, not discomfort with a price move.","Track the full portfolio and each position’s risk before trading, keeping diversification and cash available rather than making reactive, sizable adjustments.","A small gain over these periods says little about long-run skill; compare performance with the market over many periods and refine a consistent process."]}
